mode: Time acceleration within origin arc, keep Shiki's words and decisions exclusive to player.

events.event: Kusa mentor Kirisawa Seina tests drugs recovered from Post 6. One substance interferes with neuromuscular transmission, weakens respiratory muscles; second slows decomposition. No exact full formulation known. Person detained for medical experimentation; Shiki's stabilization helped save witness.

Captured post saboteur speaks under Izumi inquiry: paid to maintain abandoned post, move medicine and selectively destroy folders by conditional signal, received instructions and pay through dead drop. Does not personally know Orochimaru or Kabuto; knew only identifying privilege number for medicine release. Number matches a Kusa official who died during Konoha invasion Aug7, yet was used for medicine withdrawals afterwards, proving forged authorization after death.

Minagi Daisuke recovering under Seina care, brief questioning by Izumi with Tose present. Archive recorded 37 people with atypical tissue responses/graft compatibility years before Konoha exam; multiple administrations took over old program. One stable result but Minagi doesn't know subject or scientific meaning. Old register copy stolen years earlier. A name on medical-information requests is 'Якуши Кабуто' acting via intermediary. Minagi asserts stamps used to access medical list, not primary objective. Interview halted for dyspnea; this is a witness statement, not hard proof of Kabuto's involvement in kidnapping.

Konoha replies to Kusa official request: Kabuto Yakushi registered as Leaf genin with above-average medical expertise, disappeared during invasion; current whereabouts unknown. Konoha suspects infiltrators but doesn't share classified details. Tose recognizes Kabuto name from Shiki's reports that Leaf genin coached Shiki in medicine. Tose and Izumi have yet to learn five exchanged looks and finger gestures or Shiki's refused blood sample.

Izumi traces Shiki's unexpectedly early Aug23 07:50 assignment through forged credentials of officer dead Aug7. Original record deleted but recipient list recovered in backup; another copy went to unknown recipient via dormant Post 6 medical-comms route. Assignment medical qualification explicitly says 'ability to precisely control own physiological reactions', resembling published report of Shiki transient suppressing his hearing during Dosu fight. Reason for targeting Shiki is unknown, but deliberate selection, not random, now strongly established.

Seina reconstructs old registry, no readable 'Мугами' name and no proof Shiki in trials. One reproducible case of temporary tissue plasticity with graft tolerance, patient identity redacted; old notes demand original biological sample to reproduce adaptation. Medical records were originally gathered for care then used in research. One or more individuals with access to Kusa confidential medical archives may have leaked information, names not established.

Seina summons Shiki to her lазарет office; has old registry fragment, forged mission assignment, Kabuto exam photo. Tells Shiki someone may have targeted him in pursuit of adaptive tissue research, but no proof he was on old registry. Knows Kabuto had personal interest in Shiki medical abilities from reported meetings. As mentor rather than Kusa authority, asks direct question: «Кабуто пытался получить у тебя образец крови или других тканей?» Shiki has NOT answered yet; only player knows he explicitly refused blood sample request from Kabuto during exam.

characters.shiki: New Kusa Chunin at Seina clinic office 3 Sep 09:19. Has previously refused Kabuto blood sample and promised Kabuto private discourse; this is privately known to Shiki, not Seina, Tose, Izumi; his response awaits player.
characters.seina: Established mentor, knows Shiki unusual physiological abilities but doesn't know precisely what Kabuto asked. Protective and clinically rigorous, worried leaks used to target young medic. Has not accused Shiki's parents nor proven research subject identity.
characters.izumi: Established Kusa operations special jonin and first mission commander; investigating forged authorization and archive espionage. Does not know Kabuto/Shiki private conversations.
characters.tose: Kusa jonin team leader; knows Kabuto medical mentorship from report, not five glances/finger signal or blood refusal.
characters.minagi: Alive, no longer in acute danger, still fragile; confirms a request under Kabuto Yakushi name but hasn't independently identified him by face.
characters.saboteur: Captured alive, says paid for deliveries and arson, no known face-to-face with masterminds.

facts_and_uncertainties: Archive register existed long before the Konoha exam, 37 samples, 6 repeat observations, 1 stable result; identity of stable case deliberately redacted.
Shiki is NOT proven to be any of the 37; no user-approved origin retconned.
Document request bearing 'Якуши Кабуто' is evidence of named link but may still involve intermediaries/false identity; no confession by Kabuto.
Assignment to post 6 predated Shiki's promotion and was deliberately targeted to a particular unusual physiology. Actor unknown.
One authorization number used after rightful holder death, forged access; data integrity compromised.
The original Shiki-Kabuto dialogue included refusal to give blood, and only player may reveal this to Seina now.
